title: RemoveRequest
description: Which folder to remove, and for a worktree, what becomes of its branch: deleted once merged into a named branch, or kept at its commit.

folder.description: A folder this mode made, relative to the project, such as .forge/worktrees/my-slice.

into.description: For a worktree whose branch is deleted: the branch its own branch must be merged into before both are removed. A commit: a full or short hash, or a branch name. It has no .. and does not start with a dash.

branchAfter.description: For a worktree: what becomes of its branch. deleted, the default: the branch goes with the worktree, only when it is merged into the branch named as into. kept: the branch stays at its commit, merged or not, and into is not given. A copy has no branch, and is removed whichever is named.
